title: Saucisson vaudois with leek and potato gratin

ingredients.name: leek
ingredients.prep: trimmed, washed, sliced into 5 mm rounds

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C conventional / 160 °C fan.
Melt {butter-leeks} in a large pan over medium heat. Add {leek}, season with salt and sweat until soft.
Butter a 25 to 28 cm baking dish with {butter-dish} and cover the base with a third of {potato}. Season with salt and pepper, then add half of the leeks and half of {garlic}.
Repeat with another third of the potatoes, salt and pepper, the remaining leeks and garlic. Finish with the last third of the potatoes, salt and pepper.
Season {cream} with salt, pepper and {nutmeg} and pour evenly over the gratin. Press the layers down so the cream rises and nearly covers the top potatoes.
Scatter {gruyere} over the top, cover with foil and bake.
After 30 min of baking, put {saucisson} in a pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a bare simmer, never a boil or the casing will burst, and poach.
After 45 min of baking, remove the foil and turn the oven up to 200 °C conventional / 180 °C fan. Bake until golden and bubbling and a knife slides easily through the potatoes.
Take the gratin out of the oven and leave it to rest.
Slice the saucisson into 1 cm rounds. Serve alongside the gratin, with {mustard} on the table.
